name: protection of telomeres 1

function.text: POT1 encodes protection of telomeres protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include telomerase inhibitor activity and 8-hydroxy-2'-deoxyguanosine DNA binding. It participates in telomere maintenance via telomerase and positive regulation of telomere maintenance.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to tumor predisposition syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma; Angiosarcoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
